name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Pullover
steps: Support your head and upper back on the stability ball with your feet flat and your hips level with your thighs.
Hold one dumbbell by its inner plate with both hands directly over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep the dumbbell back toward your ears, stopping before your ribs lift.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest along the same arc by engaging your lats and keeping your ribs down.
tips: Avoid flaring your rib cage or dropping your hips as the dumbbell travels overhead.
Keep your elbows softly fixed rather than turning the pullover into a triceps extension.
